text:
alina: FYI alert from certpulse: in eu-west1 some proxies report TLS handshakes failing due to KMS DecryptDenied at 01:42 UTC. looks like the keystore role rename landed globally but eu apply errored.
marc: did we change any RBAC recently? i saw a PR renaming roles/keystore-reader -> roles/keystore-accessor merged last night.
sue: yes that PR was merged, but terraform apply in eu hit `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` on iam API at 01:38 and aborted. the new binding never reached eu.
ops-bot: logs snippet: `2026-03-22T01:41:59Z ERROR proxy-sync eu-west1 decrypt=DENIED principal=svc-proxy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/europe/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/proxy-key`
alina: mitigation suggestion: temporarily re-grant the old role roles/keystoreReader to svc-proxy in eu project to restore decrypts, then re-run terraform with retry/backoff. any objections?
sue: do it but add an audit note. also push a quick certsync after bind.
eva: compliance: we need timestamps and the audit export attached to the incident. sec-bot: create incident.
sec-bot: INCIDENT_CREATED id=INC-2026-062-keystore-eu severity=high tags=[encryption-in-transit,kms,iam] owner=@alina
marc: quick command to rebind: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:svc-proxy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/keystoreReader --project=redwood-prod`
ops-bot: executed quick bind at 01:46 UTC. certsync forced: `kubectl -n infra exec deploy/certsync -- ./certsync --region=eu-west1 --force`
ops-bot: certsync output: `2026-03-22T01:47:12Z INFO certsync decrypt=OK synced=5 hosts=proxy-eu-*`
alina: good. follow-ups: 1) pete infra to request quota bump + add exponential-backoff to per-region terraform provider; 2) add a scheduled drift detector that compares terraform state to live IAM bindings and pages on mismatch; 3) CI lint: require PRs that rename roles to include a per-region apply plan and owner acknowledgement.
eva: attach audit export with the failed apply entries and bind action to the incident for compliance. command: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.iam.v1.IAM.SetIamPolicy" OR protoPayload.status.code="RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"' --project=redwood-prod --freshness=7d --limit=200 > inc-062-audit.csv`
marc: also check KMS metrics to confirm decrypts resumed: `gcloud kms operations list --location=europe-west1 --filter="methodName:Decrypt" --limit=50`
sue: assigning owners: marc=quick infra fix + terraform retry, eva=compliance export & evidence, alina=postmortem & drift detector ticket. ETA 48h.
sec-bot: ACTIONS_ASSIGNED [marc: infra+retry, eva: audit+evidence, alina: postmortem+drift-detector] ETA=48h
alina: note for postmortem: consider adding a preflight that validates referenced service accounts exist in target region before apply, and a playbook for keystore role renames.
marc: agreed. closing thread once drift detector runs green and terraform apply in eu succeeds. :thumbsup:
